newsitem.title: UK: Burger King to open 20 outlets in Kuwait.
newsitem.headline: Burger King to open 20 outlets in Kuwait.

text.p: Burger King, fast-food chain of restaurants owned by Grand Metropolitan Plc, said it would open at least 20 franchised Burger King outlets in Kuwait during 1997 with the first one opening in February.

The outlets will be converted from Al Homaizi's existing hamburger restaurant brand called Hungry Bunny. All the meat and chicken products will be guaranteed 100 percent Halal, said Burger King in a statement.

Burger King already has 26 restaurants in the Gulf, in Saudi Arabia, United Arab Emirates, Qatar and Oman. Burger King said it planned to increase its presence in the region significantly over the next three years.
Al Homaizi Foodstuff Company is Kuwait's leading fast food company which operates 25 Hungry Bunny hamburger and chicken restaurants as well as franchises for Pizza Hut, Arbys and Taco Bell.
